assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate recurrent dizziness and giddiness against documented arrhythmia risk in a patient with a history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis codes I49.9, R42, and Z86.73 support the need for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
